name: neuro-cog-rehab
description: Monorepo for the cognitive rehabilitation auxiliary training and progress tracking platform.

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @neuro-cog-rehab/shared-types build && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @neuro-cog-rehab/shared-types build && vitest run tests/database-schema.test.ts && corepack pnpm -r test
